summary: Restore root-final ʕ before the preterit ending -le
rationale: The supplied root is ǧrʕ and the paired Infectum is maǧrəʕ. In maǧraleʕ the root-final ʕ has been displaced after the -le ending; maǧraʕle restores the root and ending order. Compare the regular -le preterits throughout the batch.
